verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents free self-hosting with no feature limitations and states that data stays entirely within your infrastructure, is never sent to Arize, and can be fully air-gapped. Deployment targets include Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, AWS CloudFormation, Google Cloud Run and Azure, so users decide where data resides. Missing for 10: documented region selection for a managed/hosted Phoenix offering, explicit residency or compliance documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Your data stays entirely within your infrastructure—nothing is sent to Arize and can be fully air-gapped.
